figures.finding: In French Polynesia, an overseas community of France under article 74 of its constitution, whose organic law decides which French statutes apply there, audiovisual policy sits with the Présidence's Direction générale de l'économie numérique (DGEN), which in October 2026 ran Pacific Genius, a week introducing fifteen school students to audiovisual trades; no Polynesian production fund or incentive was found (see blockers).

value.body: Direction générale de l'économie numérique (DGEN), Présidence de la Polynésie française

sources.said: Portée par la Présidence de la Polynésie française sous la coordination de la Direction générale de l’économie numérique (DGEN), en partenariat avec la Direction générale de l’éducation et des enseignements (DGEE) et la Direction de la jeunesse et des sports (DJS), cette initiative marque le lancement d’une semaine d’immersion consacrée aux métiers de l’audiovisuel.

the Wallis and Futuna Islands and French Polynesia shall be governed by article 73 as regards overseas departments and regions and for the territorial communities set up under the final paragraph of article 73, and by article 74 for the other communities … This status shall be determined by an organic law, passed after consultation of the Deliberative Assembly, which shall specify: the conditions in which statutes and regulations shall apply there
